description: This file contains utility functions for exporting and generating documentation in a software project, specifically by creating downloadable text files and markdown documents representing a project's solution and presentation outlines.
external_files: // DOM document for creating download links

methods.name: safeFileName(name)
methods.description: Sanitizes and truncates a string to be a safe filename.

methods.name: downloadTextFile({ filename, content, mime = "text/plain;charset=utf-8" })
methods.description: Triggers a client-side download for a text-based file with specified content and MIME type.

methods.name: buildSolutionMarkdown({ projectContext, documents, analysis, gaps })
methods.description: Constructs a structured markdown document representing a project's solution details based on provided context and analysis.

methods.name: buildPresentationMarkdown({ projectContext, analysis, gaps })
methods.description: Creates a markdown outline suitable for a presentation based on project context and analysis.

methods.name: defaultExportFilenames(projectName)
methods.description: Generates stable filenames for solution and presentation exports based on project name.

ctags.name: buildSolutionMarkdown
ctags.pattern: /^export function buildSolutionMarkdown({ projectContext, documents, analysis, gaps }) {$/
